reason: Alpha.6 PR4' (Lane 2) ships the review-wake DEFER plane as a DARK LANE: a pre-gate on the Leader control-notification port that declines a wake (never a decision) for one identified approval leg while a floor instant stands, plus the refusals and decisions it answers with. NOTHING IS WIRED — no plane flag, no root.ts import, no model-facing tool — because the round-1 review of #509 measured the only wake source in this tree (control/service.ts:2536 fires on created:true only; an existing row never re-notifies; a risen leg is deliberately never notified; approvalCaseId is minted at creation) and concluded a quiet can never be standing when its key's only wake fires, so a tool or a flag shipped today would be a control with nothing on the other end. Four lane modules: types.ts (the six laws — not a scheduler and no replay ever, not a second approval ledger, not a dedupe, not the retry mutex, not an authority, and the F-1 law stating exactly what a quiet can suppress today; the key law that a wake with no readable case is never deferred; the closed vocabularies REVIEW_DEFER_DECISIONS / _WAKE_REASONS (8) / _REFUSALS (9) / _REASON_CODES (4) and the frozen default limits, one hour and sixty-four entries). store.ts (process-local Map keyed by length-prefixed (rootSessionId, approvalCaseId, legOrdinal) so no two legitimate ids can share a slot, sweep-on-every-touch with no reaper and no timer, saturation refusing the NEW key rather than evicting a standing quiet). gate.ts (decideReviewWake pure, side-effect-free except retiring a passed OR unreadable floor; createReviewDeferGate wrapping the PORT not the deliverer, because the deliverer only ever sees a rendered string; FAIL OPEN measured against inputs that do not throw — a NaN clock or an unparseable floor delivers — with notifier rejections propagated unchanged and a throwing observer unable to suppress a wake). index.ts (barrel + the dormancy statement, whose allow-list is empty). Three runtime specs, 71 legs (refreshed for round 6 on #509, findings R6-1/R6-2/R6-6/R6-7; earlier rounds R5-5 — these numbers are descriptive, the p4t6 scanner consumes only `paths`; they were stale by three rounds, which is exactly how a descriptive count rots, so each is measured from the source rather than inherited): a6-pr4-review-defer.test.ts (43: decisions, store law, gate composition, plane behaviour, both-directions vocabulary reachability gate composition, plane behaviour, both-directions vocabulary reachability for all 8 reasons and all 9 refusals, with every producer NAMED and counted (round-4 R4-5, extended by round-5 R5-6: the census keeps the label of each producer and requires four of them for WAKE_KEY_UNADDRESSABLE, plus a leg pinning that an unreadable string clock and a throwing clock object answer two different codes and deliver either way. Round 6 added the two legs the prose had been claiming for five rounds: one drives the length-prefix collision pair (root a::b + case c against root a + case b::c) and carries the retired root::case#leg join in the same leg as its counterexample, so removing the prefixes dies by name (R6-1: the pin had never existed and the whole suite survived stripping them); the other drives a hostile toString through ALL THREE key members, not two (R6-6: swallowing a hostile rootSessionId had survived 70/70), and pins what a stringifying member really does — a one-element array answers the SAME slot as the string, while a longer array answers a slot whose width field counts elements instead of characters, which is why the derivation is a precondition on callers and not a validation layer (R6-2)), a6-pr4-mutex-negative.test.ts (17: pass-through with an empty store, composition not replacement, the fail-open law against non-throwing NaN shapes, the poisoned-store panic path naming itself, the presence pin on approvalCaseId/legOrdinal via keyof, and the leg proving the tool layer and root.ts carry NO defer vocabulary so the withdrawal cannot be quietly undone), a6-pr4-lane-hygiene.test.ts (11: dormancy walked from disk with an EMPTY allow-list, no plane flag and no gate/store/port construction anywhere in the product — and since round 6 the screened population is measured rather than asserted: the leg proves it read at least one file, proves it is a proper subset of the walk, proves no test path and no lane path is in it, and states the residual out loud, because the screen is an enumeration of three spellings and a flag named wakeHoldEnabled satisfies every assertion in it (R6-5/R6-7), no clock no timer no node: in the lane — the clock leg carries EIGHTEEN needles and a hand-written plant per needle (round-5 R5-1 added setImmediate, requestAnimationFrame, openSync, appendFileSync, unlinkSync, getRandomValues after the prose had claimed categories the twelve tokens did not cover, and the two lists are asserted equal so they cannot drift apart), and the shipped dist surface referenced by nobody). No file under packages/*/src changes in this PR (the lane's own dark modules under packages/runtime/review-defer/** are the production surface it ships, and their dist mirrors co-commit per G-4); the shared tool censuses are untouched — p6t6-bypass-scan stays at the fifteen sanctioned tools and the rc2 kit TEAM_TOOL_CATALOG stays at fifteen declared names.
